title: Add screen rotate function in "Display Configuration" widget
line: The Display Configuration widget can now rotate your screens with one click.
explanation: The Display Configuration widget only offered screen layout presets and presentation mode, so rotating a screen meant opening System Settings or running kscreen-doctor. The widget now has a Screen Rotation section with the same four rotation buttons as the Display Configuration settings page; with more than one enabled screen a picker chooses which one, defaulting to the screen the widget is on. Rotating keeps the screens to the right of or below the rotated one next to it, and the buttons are disabled with a short note when the screen rotates automatically.

commits.message:
plasmoid: add screen rotation buttons

Rotating a screen meant opening System Settings or using kscreen-doctor.
The Display Configuration widget now has a Screen Rotation section that
rotates it directly, with a screen picker when several screens are on.

BUG: 497793

media.caption: Master: the widget has no way to rotate the screen.
With the patch: a Screen Rotation section with the four rotations.
After clicking "90° Clockwise": the screen is rotated and the button is checked.
With two screens, a picker chooses which screen to rotate.
